articles.summary: Lower-income diners, long the backbone of QSR traffic, are pulling back as prices climb, while higher-income customers trade down with very different expectations. What does QSR look like when it's no longer built for its original customer?
articles.title: Modern QSRs Are Pricing Out Their Original Target Market

articles.summary: At MURTEC 2026, operators weren't asking whether AI works. They were asking how far it can go, from personalized drive-thru greetings to catching a stray pickle on a sandwich. Operator expectations are now evolving faster than deployment.
articles.title: How Operator Expectations Are Shaping the Next Phase of AI
